notes: Seed URL over http returns 403; https works. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Results are scanned or Electionware PDFs on the county Elections page (page/real.Elections). The server returns distinct per-file Last-Modified values (the 2024 summary Nov 6 2024, the canvass Nov 15 2024), so upload times are usable, though a file replaced later would hide an earlier upload. 2024 unofficial summary PDF CreationDate Wed Nov 6 03:46:48 2024 UTC (9:46 PM CST Nov 5) but the server upload is Nov 6 12:25 PM CST. The canvass PDF is image-only (no text layer); page 2 was read visually and is the SOS canvass report with county totals. No 2026 primary or runoff results are posted on the page. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not found on origin).
tag_rationale: Only the 2024 general is determined (LATER by check 2: county-total unofficial summary, no precinct numbers ever posted); the 2026 elections are UNDETERMINED, so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS with low confidence.

2024_general.fact: 'November 5th, 2024 Election Results' PDF = Electionware 'Summary Results Report UNOFFICIAL RESULTS 2024 General Election ... REAL COUNTY', county totals by Absentee/Early/Election Day only, footer '2024 GENERAL ELECTION SUMMARY REPORT -11/05/2024 9:52 PM'; Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 18:25:43 GMT (12:25 PM CST Nov 6). The only other results file is the 'Canvass report' (SOS Canvass Report, county totals, signed 11/13/24, Last-Modified Fri, 15 Nov 2024 13:48:38 GMT). No precinct-by-precinct numbers are posted.

2026_primary.fact: The 2026 Primary Election Information section lists only the notice of election, record of posting, training notice, writ and sample ballots; no results files. Check 3 pending.

2026_runoff.fact: The 2026 Primary Runoff Election Information section lists only a post-election hand count audit certification, the notice and sample ballots; no results files. Check 3 pending.
